summary: Explains how OSPF routes can be computed over MPLS traffic-engineering tunnels set up using information from another OSPF instance, so one tunnel infrastructure can serve both IPv4 and IPv6 destinations. It does this by advertising cross-address-family information.

eli5.summary: Instead of building one bridge for each kind of car, this lets both IPv4 and IPv6 traffic share one bridge.

questions: ipv4 and ipv6 te tunnel sharing
